subject: Discovery recap: Observability & evals — dashboards, hooks, golden prompts
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia@zenhealth.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: Observability & evals — dashboards, hooks, golden prompts

Hi Olivia — thanks again for a productive convo today. Below is a quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned. Please call out anything I missed or wrong.

Summary / pain points you shared:
- Lack of visibility across model rollouts: no per-prompt regressions or drift alerts tied to versions.
- Cost variability during peaks — hard to correlate app-level traffic with per-token cost.
- Difficulty reproducing customer-facing failures: missing trace context and insufficient prompt/eval artifacts.

Current stack (as discussed):
- Inference: hybrid — OpenAI hosted for non-sensitive flows, internal GPU infra for PHI workflows running on EKS in AWS (k8s + SSM).
- Observability: Datadog for infra metrics, Sentry for app errors; no model-specific telemetry today.
- Evals: ad-hoc eval notebooks maintained by ML team; no golden prompt registry or automated regression checks.

Success criteria you mentioned:
1) Per-rollout dashboards showing quality delta (acceptance rate on golden prompts, P95 latency, per-call cost).
2) Auto regression alerts on golden prompt suites before and after model/param changes.
3) Tracing hooks (request_id + prompt metadata) surfaced in your Sentry/Datadog flows so you can reproduce failures end-to-end.
4) Ability to pin model variants and a rollout guardrail (auto-fallback to previous variant on regression).

Action items / next steps (proposed):
- Redwood to share a sample dashboard template and the Eval Playbook (attached). (Marissa) — by Wed 3/18
- ZenHealth to share 2–3 representative golden prompt sets and a small sample of recent failing prompts (redacted). (Olivia) — by Fri 3/19
- Schedule a short tech sync with Marcus + Laura to map tracing hooks and Datadog integration (30m). (Marcus/Laura) — propose Thu 3/19 or Mon 3/23
- We'll draft a scoped eval plan (1–2 week run) that includes baseline metrics and regression alerts, and an estimate for Dedicated capacity if needed. (Marissa/Rishi)

Attachments: zenhealth-observability-reqs.pdf (your template), redwood-eval-playbook-v1.pdf (how we run golden prompt suites + alerts).

Thanks — excited to help you get predictable quality & cost for production inference.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0198

From: Olivia Harper <olivia@zenhealth.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@zenhealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 17:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Observability & evals — dashboards, hooks, golden prompts

Thanks Marissa — this looks right and super helpful. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Golden prompts: we'll extract 3 sets (billing questions, scheduling flow, triage triage) and redact PHI. Expect those by EOD Fri.
- Tracing: we can add a request_id at the API gateway layer but will need guidance on what prompt metadata to attach (model_version, prompt_template_id, user_tier).
- Rollout guardrail: ideally we want an automatic stop-and-rollback if golden-prompt accuracy drops >5% and latency P95 increases >20% versus baseline.

Also: one constraint — procurement requires a security questionnaire before any Docusign/PO. Happy to share the SOC2 snapshot once we sign an NDA.

Looking forward to the tech sync — Thu 3/19 at 11am PT works for Raj + me.

Olivia
Director of Product
ZenHealth
olivia@zenhealth.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 17:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Discovery recap: Observability & evals — dashboards, hooks, golden prompts

Looping you in — ZenHealth confirmed the high-level success criteria and proposed rollback thresholds. Marcus/Laura: please own the 3/19 11am PT tech sync and bring a short plan for:
- What tracing hooks we need to instrument at their API gateway and model client (list of fields we want).
- A prototype dashboard (Datadog/Grafana style) that shows quality delta on golden prompt sets + cost per-transaction.
- Outline of automated regression alert (how we evaluate, frequency, and signal thresholds).

Rishi: we'll need a scoped eval run (1 week) and a quick estimate on Dedicated vs hosted for mixed sensitive/non-sensitive flows.

I'll share the attachments and the HubSpot link before the call.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Discovery recap: Observability & evals — dashboards, hooks, golden prompts

Got it — taking the 3/19 sync. I'll prepare:
- Suggested trace payload (request_id, user_id_hash, model_version, prompt_template_id, prompt_hash, latency_ms, token_count, cost_estimate).
- Example dashboard mock (PNG) and a checklist for the integration playbook.
- Quick note on how rollback guardrail would operate (canary window, automatic fallback to previous variant, alerting to on-call).

I'll upload the dashboard mock to the shared drive and paste the link into HubSpot before the meeting.
